epic.summary: Week 2: Prompt Caching + Working/Semantic Memory (Option A)
epic.description: Implement prompt caching (v2.0.0) for immediate token cost reduction, complete OpenAI auto-cache structure for verification and adversarial agents, and establish CoALA Working + Semantic memory layers using pgvector on Supabase. Procedural and Episodic memory deferred to Week 3.
dependencies: Cache metrics from Week 1 operational (llm_cache_hit_rate, llm_cache_hit_total, llm_cache_miss_total)

decisions.scope: Option A — full caching Days 1-2, Working + Semantic memory Days 3-4, validation Day 5
decisions.vector_store: pgvector on Supabase (existing PostgreSQL stack, RLS-native, zero additional service cost)
decisions.deferred: Procedural and Episodic memory layers → Week 3
